# Mert Güneþ - Comprehensive Profile & Technical Catalog

## Overview
Mert Güneþ is a Mechatronics Engineer, AI Specialist, and Product & Technology Manager based in Istanbul, Turkey. He operates at the nexus of hardware engineering, artificial intelligence, and enterprise software, building autonomous IoT systems, local Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) models, automated business workflows, and modern web applications.

## Current Role & Professional Background
- **Product & Technology Manager** @ Alkom Technology (Jan 2026 – Present)
  - Leading China-based supplier research and technical sourcing operations.
  - Conducting comprehensive product analyses, quality assurance, and technical evaluations.
  - Formulating product positioning, competitive benchmarking, and strategic pricing models.
  - Directing website and digital technology infrastructure development.
- **Technical Support Engineer** @ DHE Industrial (Aug 2025 – Aug 2026)
  - Developed operational dashboards and reporting pipelines for business visibility.
  - Automated repetitive service processes with AI and workflow automation tools.
  - Conducted root cause analyses (RCA) and structured data analysis to optimize workflows.
  - Utilized ERP, process improvement methodologies, and pre-sales engineering support.
- **Operations & Service Engineer** @ Tepe Analitik (Aug 2023 – Mar 2025)
  - Directed end-to-end installation, calibration, and maintenance for advanced laboratory instruments.
  - Coordinated with international engineering teams for remote diagnostics and technical troubleshooting.
  - Standardized customer operational procedures across varied industrial environments.

## Key Projects Catalog
1. **Personal Portfolio Website**: Minimalist, architectural portfolio built with Next.js, Framer Motion, and high-performance technical visual systems.
2. **Interactive 3D Travel Log**: Three.js/React Three Fiber 3D globe visualizing international travel routes with custom GLSL atmospheric shaders.
3. **Offline Voice Assistant (RAG)**: Privacy-focused, zero-cloud dependency voice assistant combining Whisper v3, Qwen 2.5, and Qdrant.
4. **Industrial Data Dashboard**: Operational dataset visualization tool demonstrating data analytics and KPI reporting.
5. **End-to-End Smart Home Architecture**: Autonomous smart home network managing 20+ IoT nodes with IP zoning and 99.9% uptime.
6. **FabArm 5-DOF Robotic Arm**: 5-axis robotic manipulator with inverse kinematics mounted on an omnidirectional mecanum wheel base.
7. **Pulsar Electromobile**: Carbon-fiber electric vehicle engineered for Teknofest Efficiency Challenge (~40% weight reduction achieved).
